description: This file defines the 'AppointmentsScreen' widget for a Flutter application. It manages viewing, refreshing, and creating consultation appointments, including UI components, user interaction logic, and integration with data providers.

classes.name: AppointmentsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays a list of consultation appointments and allows authorized users to create new appointments.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the widget and fetches the list of consultations on startup.

methods.name: _create
methods.description: Displays a dialog for creating a new appointment and calls the provider to save it.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the user interface for the appointments screen, including list display, refresh controls, and a floating action button for creating appointments if authorized.
